purpose: Evaluate a deterministic ensemble for per-team corner counts against executable Bet365 team-corner markets.

cohort.eligibility: first valid Bet365 team_corners observation with at least one modelled quoted side/line

market.final_capture_policy: repeat inside FINAL window; closing benchmark is latest valid response-received snapshot before kickoff

selection.line_choice_within_team_side: largest model_minus_market_novig among qualifying quoted lines

model.ensemble: nonnegative simplex weights learned on chronological tuning data
model.calibration: single monotone Platt transform learned on chronological tuning data
model.holdout_rule: final 20 percent chronological matches untouched by weight, dispersion, ridge-hyperparameter, and calibration selection

settlement.source: TheStatsAPI match detail plus match stats
